rules.name: python_db_driver_import
rules.reason: Importing a database driver in-process bypasses the connector. Route DB access through the sanctioned connector instead.

rules.name: node_db_driver_require
rules.reason: Requiring a database driver in-process bypasses the connector. Route DB access through the sanctioned connector instead.

rules.name: jdbc_url
rules.reason: A JDBC connection URL bypasses the connector. Route DB access through the sanctioned connector instead.

rules.name: db_uri_credentials
rules.reason: A database URI with embedded credentials is a credential/target leak. Route DB access through the sanctioned connector instead.

rules.name: node_db_client_construct
rules.reason: Constructing a database client in-process bypasses the connector. Route DB access through the sanctioned connector instead.

rules.name: raw_dml_exec
rules.reason: Executing raw DML/DDL inline bypasses the connector. Route DB access through the sanctioned connector instead.
